claims.statement: aleabitoreddit identifies Sivers as a laser supplier listed on the Ayar Labs website; the relationship remains unconfirmed by a primary Ayar Labs document in this extraction.
claims.disproof_condition: If Ayar Labs' current supplier materials omit Sivers or name another laser supplier, retire this relationship.

claims.statement: aleabitoreddit's tier-3 customer map asserted 'Marvell Celestial - Direct supplier' for Sivers, but independent primary sources show the link is INDIRECT, not direct: Sivers supplies lasers to POET; POET supplied Celestial AI's optical-engine modules (POET SEC 6-K, Feb 2022); Marvell acquired Celestial AI. No primary document supports a direct Sivers->Marvell supply relationship, so the direct edge was removed. Furthermore Marvell cancelled POET's Celestial purchase orders in April 2026, cutting this indirect channel.
claims.disproof_condition: Reinstate a direct Sivers->Marvell edge only if a primary Marvell or Celestial AI document names Sivers as a direct laser supplier.
